description: NaBaCeNbO₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnnn space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.79 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.83 Å. There are two inequivalent Ba sites. In the first Ba site, Ba is bonded to twelve O atoms to form BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with four equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent CeO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.96-3.01 Å. In the second Ba site, Ba is bonded to twelve O atoms to form distorted BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with four equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent CeO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.79-3.18 Å. Ce is bonded to six O atoms to form CeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NbO₆ octahedra and faces with four BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-12°. There are a spread of Ce-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.26 Å. Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CeO₆ octahedra and faces with four BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-12°. There are four shorter (2.02 Å) and two longer (2.03 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ba, one Ce, and one Nb atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ba, one Ce, and one Nb atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Ba, one Ce, and one Nb atom.
